validation.notes.value: Official RUA ORIGINAL bitstream for the publisher article checked; RUA API MD5 matches the fetched PDF. Methods §4.1 p. 4 describes BioVid subset A and class labels. Table 2 p. 5 reports PainFusion+ frozen-ViViT accuracy 35.40% default split, 33.85% demographic hold-out, and 40.25% LOSO. Methods §4.1 says default split is class-stratified 80% training, 10% of training validation, 20% test, but does not state participant-disjointness; LOSO is the separate across-individual protocol. The text describes a 90-person healthy-adult BioVid dataset but does not separately identify the analyzed denominator. No chronic-pain, ECAP or SCS validation is established.
